scope: Read-only numerical extraction from the existing d348 diagnostic; no runtime, browser, tests, or measurement rerun. No private raw trace read/copied.
limitations: Original 100-switch/200-input primary totals and thresholds unchanged. Draft-reset100 retained separately.
Node spans include transport and scheduling. Browser and Node clocks are not subtracted. Quantiles are not additive.
EventTiming is thresholded at16ms and browser duration is rounded; absent matches are not zero. Nested events and handlers are not additive.
Input-event matching associates dispatch by one same-document handler interval, not React function attribution.
No longtask or React profiler data exist in this run. Source-supported optimizations have no measured latency attribution.
Different original4df and d348 runs are sequential diagnostics; no causal subtraction or claim of matched external load.

targets.measurement: Original All projects→open saved Define context→two frames; input→expected field→two frames; no physical-input claim
